name: 5-Port Gigabit Desktop PoE+ Switch with 1-Port PoE++ In and 4-Port PoE+Out TP-Link TL-SG1005P-PD
summary: 5-Port Gigabit Desktop PoE+ Switch with 1-Port PoE++ In and 4-Port PoE+Out
TL-SG1005P-PD is a standard PoE switch.
It has 1-Port Gigabit PoE++ In and 4-Port PoE+ Out, supporting up to 66 W PoE budget.
Chuẩn và Giao thức: IEEE 802.3i, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3af, IEEE 802.3at, IEEE 802.3bt, IEEE 802.3x, IEEE 802.1p
Giao diện: 5× 10/100/1000Mbps RJ45 Ports; 1× 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 PoE In Ports (compliance with 802.3af/at/bt Type3/bt Type4); 4× 10/100/1000 Mbps RJ45 PoE Out Ports (compliance with 802.3af/at)

Mạng Media: 10; BASE-T: UTP category 3, 4, 5 cable (maximum 100m); EIA/TIA-568 100Ω STP (maximum 100m); 100; BASE-TX: UTP category 5, 5e cable (maximum 100m); EIA/TIA-568 100Ω STP (maximum 100m); 1000
specs: IEEE 802.3i, IEEE 802.3u, IEEE 802.3ab, IEEE 802.3af, IEEE 802.3at, IEEE 802.3bt, IEEE 802.3x, IEEE 802.1p

PoE Out Ports: Ports 1-4, compliance with 802.3af/at
